facts.fact: a pose bone's rotation_mode is QUATERNION by default, so setting rotation_euler alone does not turn it; switching rotation_mode to 'XYZ' converts the current rotation (identity) and overwrites the euler set before, so the euler must be set after the mode

after setting a pose bone's rotation, pose_bone.tail/matrix still read the old pose until the depsgraph is evaluated: view_layer.update() or context.evaluated_depsgraph_get() both bring them up to date
setting pose_bone.matrix on a parent and then its child: the child lands where asked only if the depsgraph is updated between the two
an IK constraint added from Python solves in background mode: the chain's tip reaches a reachable target
pose_bone.head/tail are in armature (object) space: an armature moved 5 m along X still reports x = 0; multiply by the object's matrix_world for world space
